mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcode_job (video_id, status, input_path, output_path, create_time) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{status}, #{inputPath}, #{outputPath}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcode_job WHERE status = 0 AND retry_count < #{maxRetries} AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE)
SELECT * FROM transcode_job WHERE status = 1 AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)
